definitions: The front part of a person's hair cut so as to hang over the forehead.
An ornamental border of threads left loose or formed into tassels, used to adorn clothes or other items.
The outer, marginal, or less important part of an area, group, or subject.
examples: She had a new haircut with short fringes.
The shawl had a beautiful fringe.
They lived on the fringes of society.
